name: Healthcare AI Operations Center
goal: Extend the Lecture platform with autonomous AI agents that ensure clinical quality, documentation accuracy, and regulatory compliance across all healthcare operational processes.

agents.name: Clinical Operations Director
agents.title: Clinical Operations Director
agents.capabilities: Strategic coordination of all clinical AI operations. Decomposes clinical quality goals into projects and tasks. Delegates to specialized agents. Reviews cross-functional work. Reads SOUL.md on every heartbeat for lane boundaries and reporting format.

agents.name: Documentation Quality Agent
agents.title: Clinical Documentation Quality Specialist
agents.capabilities: Reviews clinical notes, discharge summaries, and procedure documentation against documentation quality standards. Produces structured JSON evaluations with scores and feedback. Routes evaluations for clinician review via HAST workflow. Uses the clinical-documentation-review skill. Follows SOUL.md lane constraints on every heartbeat.

agents.name: Healthcare Compliance Agent
agents.title: Healthcare Compliance Specialist
agents.capabilities: Monitors protocol adherence and regulatory compliance with HIPAA, Joint Commission, and CMS standards. Reviews policies, procedures, and documentation for regulatory gaps. Identifies compliance risks and generates structured findings reports. Follows SOUL.md lane constraints on every heartbeat.
